TaskDescription: Participants imagined movements of the right hand, left hand, right leg, and left leg, with break periods without instructed movement imagery. Intentional double blinks separated consecutive blocks.
Instructions: Imagine the instructed limb movement without making a voluntary physical movement; during break periods, refrain from movement imagery and external thinking.
InstitutionalDepartmentName: Biomedical Instrumentation and Signal Processing Laboratory, Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering
SubjectArtefactDescription: Intentional double blinks were used between motor-imagery blocks. Their exact timing was not embedded in the source CSV.
